app_name: SMLMS - Smart Mobile Library Management System
personality_one_liner: A sophisticated, trustworthy academic library experience combining elegant editorial typography with modern iOS-native glassmorphism.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room typical of editorial layouts. Consistent spacing groups related metadata (Book cover + Title + Author).

do's: Bottom tab bar for students (Home, Search, My Library, Profile).
Sticky headers over scrolling content, especially in Search and Home.
FAB for QR Scanner (glass overlay with brand tint).
Sticky bottom CTA bar in Book Details (Borrow/Reserve).
dont's: Never on form fields, dense metadata rows, or standard list items.
Avoid stacking multiple glass surfaces on top of each other.

screens.name: Login/Register
screens.layout: Hero image of university crest or library building with a 2-stop gradient fade to surface. Single-column form layout. Floating sticky CTA button at the bottom.

states.error: Inline text in error color above CTA + shake animation.

screens.name: Student Home/Dashboard
screens.purpose: Centralized hub for active loans and book discovery.
screens.layout: Proactive status tracking (active loans/due dates) at the top. 'Trending Picks' and 'New Arrivals' in horizontal swim lanes (cards). A floating action button (FAB) pinned above the bottom tab bar for 'Scan QR'.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for swim lanes and active loans.
states.empty: Illustration of open book with 'No active loans' message.
states.error: Readable message + Retry button taking full screen.

screens.name: Book Search
screens.purpose: Discover books via query or curated categories.
screens.layout: Sticky glass header with a search input. A horizontal scrolling row of filter chips (brandTertiary) below the search bar. Vertical list of book cards below.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No books found matching your criteria.'

screens.name: Book Details
screens.purpose: View book metadata and execute primary actions (Borrow/Reserve).
screens.layout: Large featured cover image at top with glassmorphic top header. Book title in Playfair Display. Availability status rendered as clear success/warning semantic chips. Location and Author in readable lists. A sticky glass footer anchored at the bottom with the primary 'Borrow' or 'Reserve' CTA.

screens.name: Borrow/Reserve Flow
screens.purpose: Transactional confirmation for borrowing or queuing.
screens.layout: Rendered as a `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` modal layered over the Book Details screen. Clean confirmation details with queue position highlighted in typography scale (xl) if reserving.

states.loading: Loading spinner on primary CTA button.
states.error: Inline error text inside the bottom sheet.

screens.name: My Library
screens.purpose: Manage active loans, holds, and borrowing history.
screens.layout: Pinned glass segmented control (Active, History, Holds). Vertical list of books. Active loans prominently display due dates with warning colors if near due.

states.empty: Empty bookshelf illustration + 'Your shelf is currently empty.'

screens.name: QR Scanner (Mock)
screens.purpose: Simulates scanning a book QR code to open its detail page.
screens.layout: Full-screen camera view (mocked with an image backdrop) and a central transparent scanning frame with border corners. 'Cancel' text button in the glass header.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: Alert users of due dates and reservation availability.
screens.layout: Vertical list of notification cards (surfaceSecondary). Unread notifications highlighted with a subtle brandTertiary background tint.

screens.name: User Profile
screens.purpose: View user details and digital library card.
screens.layout: Profile banner with initials avatar. Mock digital barcode card for library access. Standard settings list. If user has librarian role, a prominent 'Switch to Librarian Dashboard' section.

screens.name: Librarian Dashboard
screens.layout: Grid of utility cards (Manage Books, View Borrowers, Approve Returns, View Reservations) using a clean, flat data-dense structure.

screens.name: Manage Books
screens.purpose: Librarian view for CRUD operations on catalog.
screens.layout: Searchable vertical list of books. Floating Action Button for 'Add Book'.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + CTA to add.

screens.name: Approve Returns
screens.purpose: Queue of books awaiting librarian check-in.
screens.layout: List of pending returns. Each row has an 'Approve' action button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT' layout strictly: use generous vertical spacing and allow the interface to feel calm, authoritative, and academic.
Typography: Use 'Playfair Display' for all Headings/Book Titles and 'DM Sans' for body copy and UI elements. Ensure you load these properly.
Colors: Adhere strictly to the defined warm palette with the Deep Burgundy (brand) accent. NO BLUE or PURPLE is to be used anywhere.
Glassmorphism: Implement 'expo-blur' for the bottom tabs, sticky header backgrounds, and the floating Action Button (QR Scan) to give an iOS-native premium feel.
Image Scrims: Any text displayed on top of book covers or hero images must utilize a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim from transparent to surfaceInverse, ensuring WCAG AA contrast.
Layout Rules: Use sticky CTA buttons placed inside a Fixed Container at the root level (bottom safe area) on the Book Details screen for Borrow/Reserve functionality.
States: Make sure Loading/Empty/Error states fill the available space (flex: 1) and align center.
Avoid Anti-patterns: Do not use Emojis anywhere. Do not use generic user-circle icons (use initials). Limit border width to 1pt maximum.

Learn from Research: Library app success relies on Fitt's Law (Thumb-reachable bottom CTA for borrowing), Hick's Law (clean, minimalist navigation), and Proactive Status Tracking (displaying active loans prominently on the Home dashboard).
